subject: Re: Booth reposition request — concourse edge + brand lockup review
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Evans <sarah@eventworks.com>, EventWorks Ops <ops@eventworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Booth reposition request: concourse edge + brand lockup check

Hi Sarah / Ops team,

Quick ask as we're finalizing the exhibit footprint for CloudCon: we want to request moving from our currently assigned corner island (H12) to the concourse-edge slot labeled B (adjacent to main thoroughfare). Reason: sustained demo queue overflow last year and the concourse edge would give predictable walk-by traffic for short demos.

Can you confirm feasibility and any implications for:
- power routing / dedicated drop location
- AV cable chase and rental lead times
- sightlines to the concourse (any required sightline waivers)
- neighbor booths and potential noise conflicts

Also: attached is our current site-plan-v6.pdf and the latest backwall artwork. Before we lock signage orders we need confirmation on the brand lockup safe zone: marketing wants a 24" clear margin from the top and logos at 1200px (approx. 40" at print). Please confirm if the concourse B orientation affects maximum backwall height or required setback.

If concourse B is possible, next steps from our side: finalize backwall artwork, sign off on signage specs, and place crate/graphics shipping labels. Would appreciate a preliminary footprint + estimated lead times by EOD Tuesday so we can align procurement.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Field Marketing Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: site-plan-v6.pdf (pdf)

From: Sarah Evans <sarah@eventworks.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: EventWorks Ops <ops@eventworks.com>, Jeremy Lowe <jeremy@venue.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth reposition request: concourse edge + brand lockup check

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear brief and the plan PDF.

Good news: concourse-edge B is tentatively available but we need to confirm a couple of constraints. I've attached two alternate footprints (concourse-edge-options.pdf) — Option A preserves your 10x20 demo pit with an angled gateway; Option B reorients the backwall to maximize line-of-sight from the concourse (smaller demo pit footprint but more prime visibility).

I need the following to proceed with a locked assignment:
1) exact crate dimensions for inbound (we have two dock windows and limited surge capacity)
2) confirmed demo pedestal footprint (width x depth) for AV cable routing
3) whether you need an overhead lighting rig (would require 30 days lead time and venue approval)

On brand lockup: the concourse B orientation should allow an 8ft backwall height without additional setback, however Jeremy from venue needs to confirm sightline waivers for any elevated signage above 8ft. If you can send the high-res lockup guideline, we can fast-track poster mounting specs.

I can schedule a 30-min site call tomorrow morning with the venue team — does 10am work?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Evans
Senior Event Producer, EventWorks

Attachments: concourse-edge-options.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth reposition request: concourse edge + brand lockup check

Looping in quickly — preference internally is Option B (the reoriented backwall) because it funnels demo traffic into a linear queue and reduces cross-traffic. A couple of clarifications from Marketing:
- Brand lockup guidance attached (brand-lockup-guidelines.png). We need a 24" top margin as Soojin noted.
- Backwall height: confirm max 8ft is firm; anything above that needs legal and biz approval for elevated signage.
- Signage materials: foamcore for hero panels, dye-sub for fabric banners.

If EventWorks can guarantee an on-site inspection window on move-in day (we'll confirm exact crate arrival) we'll greenlight Option B and proceed with signage PO.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Events Producer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: brand-lockup-guidelines.png (png)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Evans <sarah@eventworks.com>, EventWorks Ops <ops@eventworks.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth reposition request: concourse edge + brand lockup check

Sarah / Ops — technical constraints from our side:
- Primary crate (graphics + demo gear): 48" x 40" x 56" (palletized). We need a straight path from dock to booth, no 90° turns larger than 30" in narrow corridors.
- Demo pedestal footprint: 30" x 30" (two pedestals for two simultaneous demos).
- AV: we require a powered AV subrack and 2x 20A drops; power drop location preference: rear-left corner of footprint in Option B.
- ADA: need 36" clear aisle on main concourse-facing side at all times.

Please confirm neighbors on both sides in concourse B — if either neighbor is a loud activation we may need additional acoustic shielding or move back to the island. Also need the venue loading window: earliest we can start crate unload is 0800 move-in day per our carrier.

Thanks — Logan
Logan Wright
Logistics Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Evans <sarah@eventworks.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth reposition request: concourse edge + brand lockup check

All — thanks for the rapid turnaround. Confirming final plan: Option B (Concourse Edge B) is approved and reserved for Redwood pending DocuSign confirmation.

Action items completed on our side:
- Attached: final-concourse-b-footprint.pdf (shows power drop rear-left, 36" clear on concourse side).
- Attached: order-signage-specs.xlsx (spec sheet for foamcore hero panels and fabric banners).
- Neighbors: Booths B11 and B13 will be adjacent; B11 has a quiet software demo, B13 is a sponsor photo wall (moderate sound). No amplified stage next to you.
- Loading: Jeremy Lowe confirmed two dock windows (0800 and 1200) — we'll reserve the 0800 window for Redwood now.

Next steps for Redwood:
1) Sign the aisle-change DocuSign (link below) to finalize footprint assignment.
2) Confirm signage PO against order-signage-specs.xlsx (we need the PO by Friday to meet print deadlines).
3) Confirm if you need an overhead rig (venue still requires a waiver if >8ft).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/Redwood-Booth-Aisle-Change-12345

I'll schedule the site inspection for move-in morning 0800 and copy logistics. If you sign today we can lock the 0800 dock.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Evans
Senior Event Producer, EventWorks

Attachments: final-concourse-b-footprint.pdf, order-signage-specs.xlsx
